diagrams.h2: Block, file and object storage are interfaces
diagrams.text:
Disk / cloud volume (blocks) → filesystem (files/directories) → applications
Object store (objects + metadata + API) → object-aware clients/applications
Physical disks / remote volumes → RAID / LVM / storage pool → logical block volume → filesystem → mount point

Host Linux kernel
   ├── Container A: processes + libraries + mount/network namespaces
   └── Container B: processes + libraries + mount/network namespaces

Physical server → hypervisor → VM A (guest kernel + apps)
                             → VM B (guest kernel + apps)
